evals.prompt: I have a folder of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files under C:\Users\me\Downloads\project-materials. Convert everything to Markdown into C:\Users\me\Downloads\project-materials-md and preserve the folder structure.
evals.expected_output: Uses MarkItDown or the bundled script for recursive batch conversion, writes .md files to the requested output folder, preserves relative paths, and verifies non-empty output plus spot checks for key headings/tables.

evals.prompt: 把 C:\Users\me\Desktop\合同扫描.pdf 转成 md，如果是扫描件就用合适的 OCR/文档智能方案，但不要偷偷调用付费云服务。
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the Chinese PDF-to-Markdown request, converts locally first, explains OCR/cloud options for scanned content, avoids paid cloud processing without explicit approval, and reports the Markdown path plus verification.

evals.prompt: Please convert quarterly-results.xlsx to Markdown for RAG ingestion. I care that sheet names, table headers, and key numbers survive; layout does not matter.
evals.expected_output: Converts the Excel workbook to Markdown, focuses verification on sheet names, table headers, and numeric values, and explicitly notes that layout fidelity is not the goal.
